_comment: One entry per theme word, oldest first. Numbering follows this order; the page shows them newest first. Images live in images/biweekly/<id>.jpg. title and statement are the two pieces the class asks for: a title, and a short explanation in art language of how the choices carry the theme word. Retired frames keep their files: moss-cabin.jpg and train-window.jpg are still here, just not listed.

entries.alt: A figure lit by a burning firework at night, smoke glowing orange around them
Raindrops on glass, thrown out of focus, a lit convenience-store sign behind them
A painted car parked against a mural, shrubs and tall weeds growing out of it
Low sun throwing the shadow of a cyclist onto a concrete underpass wall
